findings.issue: The row tells the reader "A node needs one iteration per configured dimension, so set `--max-iterations` to at least `ceil(nodes / lineages) * dimensions` for the depth-1 band." That minimum funds only half the band. `applyReviewFrontierBudget` gives the depth-1 band `budgetSplit.depth1` (0.5) of `maxIterations`, counts every depth-1 visit against it, and closes the remaining depth-1 nodes `exhausted` with reason `budget`, so `nodes/lineages * dimensions` iterations leave about half the node-dimension pairs unfunded. The per-node requirement is also the four canonical dimensions plus configured custom names (`buildDimensionUniverse` starts from `REQUIRED_DIMENSIONS`), not just the configured subset, so the formula understates further when a subset is chosen.

The YAML START CONDITION says to load the YAML only when ALL required inputs are bound, but the list omits `depth_mode` (and `convergence_mode`). The workflow preflight requires `depth_mode` in `required_values_present` and populates `antiConvergence.depthMode` from it, so an orchestrator that follows this list loads the YAML with `{depth_mode}` unbound. The same incomplete list is repeated in the mode-routing step at line 83.
